method.process_isolation: One fresh process per measured profile.
method.compiler_caches: Fresh TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR, TRITON_CACHE_DIR, and CUDA_CACHE_PATH per measured profile.
method.device_timing: CUDA synchronized before and after inference.
method.timing_runs: Warm-up and measured-run counts are recorded with each reference and candidate; they were not uniform across models.
method.harness_fail_closed: The current harness requires an eager baseline, uses unique run artifact paths, rejects any nonzero worker exit, and rejects nondeterministic repeated output.

quality_evaluator.normalized_value_source: The checked raw-evidence artifact's pinned post-hoc ASR pass; it supersedes ASR values in earlier summary artifacts.
quality_evaluator.scope: Fixture-level WER/CER is supplementary. It is not a perceptual quality score.

quality_policy: Every real-checkpoint reference and completed candidate produced at least 10 seconds of audio.
Text, model-specific conditioning, checkpoint, and seed were fixed inside each paired comparison.
Exact waveform equality is required when an optimization is expected to be numerically invariant.
A non-exact regional-kernel result can pass only on the measured fixture when duration and transcript metrics do not regress and waveform SNR remains high.
Reduced precision, fewer sampling steps, or caching is rejected when WER, CER, duration, or the strict waveform gate regresses or is unavailable for a changed waveform.
A fixture-level pass is not a general perceptual-quality claim.

evidence_tier_definitions.real-checkpoint-end-to-end: Released or published weights ran from model inputs through a waveform of at least 10 seconds on the RTX 4090.
evidence_tier_definitions.tiny-graph: A synthetic or tiny local graph executed in tests. It is not public-weight inference and carries no RTX 4090 performance claim.
evidence_tier_definitions.static-plan: Lazy construction and optimization-plan resolution passed without loading or executing weights.

real_checkpoint_status_definitions.measured: A real checkpoint completed the long-audio RTX 4090 benchmark.
real_checkpoint_status_definitions.blocked: A specific access, artifact, conditioning, or reproducibility requirement prevented a comparable real-checkpoint run.
real_checkpoint_status_definitions.not-run: No real-checkpoint benchmark was attempted in this evidence set.
real_checkpoint_status_definitions.unsupported: The public high-level waveform-generation contract deliberately fails closed.

candidate_decision_definitions.accepted: Passed the measured quality policy and improved steady performance.
candidate_decision_definitions.no-benefit: Passed the measured quality policy but did not provide a material performance win.
candidate_decision_definitions.rejected: Completed, but failed the quality policy.
candidate_decision_definitions.blocked: Did not complete, so no speed or quality result is claimed.

vits.reason: Bit-exact output and a 1.047830x mean speedup in the primary paired run; peak allocated memory increased by 53.92 MiB.

f5tts.reason: 1.111493x steady mean speedup and 4.009862% lower peak allocated memory with unchanged fixture WER and 51.31 dB SNR.
f5tts.cold_start_warning: Cold inference was 130.160340 seconds versus 6.329852 seconds. The exact crossover is after about 205.45 subsequent requests, so whole-request workloads need 206 additional requests (207 total).

neutts.reason: SDPA was already native and slower on the mean; regional compile changed duration and doubled CER.

supertonic.reason: Compile was exact but slower, while both step reductions increased WER.

vui.reason: Both compile policies changed sequence length or transcript quality and inference compile now fails closed.

limitations: Only five of 34 registered TTS providers have real-checkpoint, long-audio RTX 4090 measurements in this artifact.
Tiny-graph and static-plan evidence must not be interpreted as downloaded-weight inference, quality, speed, or memory validation.
The checked raw-evidence artifact retains the measured-run inputs, commands, profile configurations, checkpoint identities, timings, memory metrics, waveform hashes, and ASR evaluator identity.
WER and CER use one fixed ASR evaluator and fixture; listening tests and broader text/speaker sets remain necessary.
The five real-checkpoint results cover one fixed fixture per model; broader text, speaker, language, and listening evaluations remain necessary.
